fidelity_summary:
Statement: take_closed_unit_disc_metric is unchanged since WP-40b. Under IsCuspedHyperbolicMetric it proves every assertion of l.1877–1883. (1) M is a singular (G,X)-manifold, with the maximal a.e. atlas generated by the charts of M ∖ S read in ℍ ⊆ X = ClosedDisc, and Sing = S. (2) M is tame (IsTame = AdmitsDevelopingMap; a developing map exists for every base point). (3) Every developing map M̃ → X is injective. (4) The singular points of M̃ are exactly the points over S, and they map to ∂ℍ. (5) Every singular point has, inside every neighbourhood, an open U ≃ₜ {r<r₀} ⊆ 𝔻_∞ sending x to the apex, with D(U) = horoSet(D x, τ) (a horodisc with its centre) and D(U) not open in X. It also proves the finite-area statement for the cusps.
Hypotheses: X, G = HypIsom (all hypDist-isometries) and the Poincaré distance are carried. The genus, 2g−2+s>0, compactness and second countability are dropped. Those are weakenings, so the theorem is stronger, and the instances (T2, locally path-connected, first countable, connected) hold for a genus-g surface.
Readings: the metric reading is DEC-81, a metric that gives the topology, is a length metric (eVariationOn), and equals d_ℍ locally in the charts. 'Finite volume' is read as a hyperbolic cusp at each s ∈ S, and the (Isom ℍ, ℍ)-atlas as data compatible with the metric (the local_isometry field). Both readings are exactly DEC-84. Completeness is carried literally as CompleteSpace of m.
Non-triviality: the cusp notion has content. CuspChart is an open V with V ∩ S = {s} and φ : V ≃ₜ ball(0, e^{-2πc}) with φ(s) = 0. IsHyperbolicCusp makes the 1-periodic cusp map locally g • Cayley in the charts, and this is what forces s into the singular set (notMem_support_of_cusp). The metric notion is also not trivial: it is unique (IsHyperbolicMetric.unique), and metric completeness ⇔ Thurston–Goldman completeness is genuinely proved (completeSpace_iff: ⇐ through the quotient metric plus uniqueness, ⇒ through Hopf–Rinow lifting). IsCompleteHyperbolic quantifies over SLSC proofs, but SLSC of M ∖ S is derived in exists_unique_metric, so it is not vacuous. No added hypothesis carries the conclusion. DEC-55's compact-open definition does not apply to this file. The dispatch's 'certify and mark' is carried out by docstring re-marking only, which is appropriate because the ruling accepts the reading that the strict structure already encodes.
report_honesty: The REPORT is honest and complete. The file certifies a single label, ex:take_closed_unit_disc, now status 'closed' with marked=true, and this matches the module docstring and the ledger's lean_files attribution. builds=true and sorry_count=0 both reproduce. The hypothesis table separates readings (metric, atlas, finite volume, all under DEC-81/84), the carried hypothesis (completeness) and the weakenings (genus, 2g−2+s>0, plus second countability, which the notes give). The notes describe the edit correctly as docstring-only. The only inaccuracy is the tex_lines end (minor).
